import sys

def min_changes_to_cook_all_skewers(n, p, b):
    # Create a list to track the visited positions for each skewer
    visited = [set() for _ in range(n)]
    
    # Simulate the process of moving and reversing skewers
    for i in range(2 * n):
        new_visited = [set() for _ in range(n)]
        for j in range(n):
            # Move skewer j to position p[j] - 1
            new_pos = p[j] - 1
            # Add the current position and the reversed position to the visited set
            new_visited[new_pos].add((j, b[j]))
            if b[j] == 1:
                new_visited[new_pos].add((j, 1 - b[j]))
        visited = new_visited
    
    # Count the number of skewers that have visited all 2n positions
    fully_visited_count = sum(len(v) == 2 * n for v in visited)
    
    # Calculate the minimum number of changes needed
    min_changes = n - fully_visited_count
    
    return min_changes

    p = list(map(int, data[1:n+1]))
    b = list(map(int, data[n+1:2*n+1]))
    
    result = min_changes_to_cook_all_skewers(n, p, b)
